title.zh: 生成之论脊柱上的生生之意义：由种子与边界中立刻画
title.en: Living significance on the Becoming spine, characterized by a seed and boundary neutrality

claim.zh: 在同一框架（核心过程加主张赋值）上陈述评价，不另立世界模型。在已形成关系把生生连在一起、且有某一生生的整体上，“每一生生从每一立场都有正面意义”（生生之意义在主张层的形式）等价于三项合取：某处有一个生生被某立场珍视（种子；任何持自身意义且有自身生生的位置都提供一个）；正面意义沿非零的已形成关系传递（关系中立）；对生生的正面意义不随立场而取消（立场中立）。位置化表述 D 由外在论表述 A 推出。一个以新生生为目标的 sound 探究，使每个对它有通达的位置都具有支持它的一项理由。种子、关系中立、立场中立、连通与 A 各有一个一致的反模型；每个规范对手都恰是同一规则加上一条已形成的边界（自身区域、自身立场、认同者）。提升规则 L 只有经由一个可行的中间回应才传递。
claim.en: Evaluation is stated over one frame (the core process with realized claims), with no world model of its own. On a whole where formed relations connect living and further generation and some such claim exists, “every living claim is significant from every standpoint” (living significance at claim level) is equivalent to three conjuncts: some living claim is valued from some standpoint (a seed; any position holding self-significance with own living supplies one); significance passes along nonzero formed relations (relational neutrality); and significance of living content holds from every standpoint (standpoint neutrality). The positioned articulation D follows from the externalist articulation A. A sound inquiry whose goal is new living content gives every position with access a contributory reason for it. Seed, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality, connection and A each have a consistent countermodel, and each normative rival is the same rule restricted by a formed boundary (own region, own standpoint, endorsers). The lifting rule L is transitive only through a live middle response.

hypotheses.zh: S0、N_rel、N_std、A 是公开的规范前提，本结果不证明它们；它不用公理刻画 G0 的内容；G0 原是 Ren 采用的公理，Ren 2026-10-11 把它折叠，此后它在第一部分是条件（P51），以那一条公理为条件它是定理；Ren 2026-10-16 把第二部分折叠为章节 §6.15 的条件小节（R36 起为 §6.4），理论不断言那一条公理（P128）。“G0 ⇒ 前提”一侧几乎是平凡的，内容在反方向与极小性。
hypotheses.en: S0, N_rel, N_std and A are explicit normative premises, not proved here; the result characterizes G0's content with no axiom; G0 was Ren's adopted axiom until Ren folded it on 11 October 2026, after which it is a condition in Part I (P51) and a theorem with the one axiom as a condition; on 16 October 2026 Ren folded Part II into the conditional section 6.15 of the chapter (section 6.4 since R36), and the theory does not assert the one axiom (P128). The direction from G0 to the premises is nearly immediate; the content lies in the converse and in minimality.

hypotheses.zh: A 是关于有贡献理由的外在论表述：在所见范围上确保自身立场下的正面内容、且有通达，即有一项支持理由；不以认同为条件。
hypotheses.en: A is an externalist articulation of contributory reasons: securing positive content from one's own standpoint on the response's scope, with access, supplies a contributory reason; endorsement is not a condition.

hypotheses.zh: 连通与 sound 是关于展开与探究的条件；所见范围由策略的实际执行定义，不是自由参数。
hypotheses.en: Connection and soundness are conditions on the unfolding and the inquiry; the visible scope is defined by the policy's actual executions, not a free parameter.

correspondence.zh: living 读作生生；对应 Ren 的 G0 时取更新型形成的关系读法（relational-renewal-classification、relational-reading-comparison），这是对应，不是本模块的 Lean 结果。related 是非零的已形成关系（条件、依存、传承、合作），在应用中须有证据；位置的通达可写成被实现的主张（AccessAt）。有限模型中的两个立场与三个生命只用于极小性。在 Becoming 层，living 与 related 的读法都取自一次运行（becoming-renewal-reading、becoming-stepwise-reading），所以连通与 universal_reason 的应用相对于该运行；不依赖运行的读法尚未给出。
correspondence.en: `living` reads 生生; matching Ren's G0 uses the relational reading of renewing formation (relational-renewal-classification, relational-reading-comparison), a correspondence and not a Lean result of this module. `related` is a nonzero formed relation (conditioning, dependence, descent, cooperation) needing evidence in each application; a position's access can be a realized claim (AccessAt). The finite model's two standpoints and three lives serve minimality only. On the Becoming layer, the readings of `living` and `related` are taken from one run (becoming-renewal-reading, becoming-stepwise-reading), so connection and the application of universal_reason are relative to that run; a run-independent reading is not yet given.

detail.zh: 本结果给出该审查要求的 P+ 版第二步：容差换成沿非零已形成关系的传递（N_rel），BI 是 N_rel 的特例，立场到规范的桥是 N_std。未建立两模块间的形式转换。
detail.en: This result supplies the P+ version of step two that its review requested: tolerance becomes transmission along nonzero formed relations (N_rel), BI is an instance of N_rel, and the standpoint-to-normative bridge is N_std. No formal adapter between the two modules is established.

detail.zh: 推进而未完成：把普遍理由所需的规范内容精确定位为种子、两条中立与 A；不及于拒绝它们的立场。
detail.en: Advances without completing it: locates the normative content universal reasons need exactly in a seed, two neutralities and A; positions rejecting them are not bound.

detail.zh: 同一 GenerativeComparison.G0 谓词；本结果在脊柱上给出该谓词由种子与中立推出的条件。
detail.en: Same GenerativeComparison.G0 predicate; this result gives conditions on the spine under which it follows from a seed and neutrality.

detail.zh: living 的关系读法与 C 的严格排序来自该结果；本模块只陈述 C 在框架上的形式（Comparison）。
detail.en: The relational reading of `living` and C's strict ranking come from that result; this module only states C's form on the frame (Comparison).

detail.zh: 解释关联：承受者一侧的 N_rel 阻止“自身谱系”边界取消人类的意义；正面性不带权重，与强烈偏倚相容，权重仍由 J 承担。
detail.en: Interpretive connection: patient-side N_rel blocks a lineage boundary from cancelling human significance; positivity carries no weight and is compatible with strong partiality, so weights remain with J.

detail.zh: 核心自己陈述 D 与确保的正面根据；桥接层的 positionedArticulation_iff 与 securesPositiveGround_iff 表明它们就是该结果的定义，因此 every_situated_position_has_reason 等定理直接适用。universal_reason 在核心内以同样两步证明，不调用它。
detail.en: The core states D and the secured positive ground itself; the bridge's positionedArticulation_iff and securesPositiveGround_iff show that they are that result's definitions, so every_situated_position_has_reason and its companions apply directly. universal_reason is proved in the core by the same two steps without calling it.

detail.zh: 现时目的（无种子）：两条中立都空洞成立，没有任何东西有意义。
detail.en: Present aim (no seed): both neutralities hold vacuously and nothing is significant.

detail.zh: 只在自身区域内传递：持自身意义、种子与立场中立，在自身区域内满足传递规则，却不给相连的他者意义。
detail.en: Transmission inside the own region only: holds self-significance, a seed and standpoint neutrality and satisfies the transmission rule inside its own region, yet gives the connected other no significance.

detail.zh: 立场相对：每个立场内传递成立，只与自身立场共享，旁观立场无任何意义。
detail.en: Standpoint-relative: transmission holds within each standpoint, significance is shared only with itself, and the bystander's standpoint has none.

detail.zh: 无连通：一切规范前提成立，意义止于已形成关系所及之处；零关系的发生不自动获得意义。
detail.en: No connection: every normative premise holds and significance stops where formed relations stop; a zero-relation occurrence gains none automatically.

detail.zh: 内在论：生生之意义完全成立，只给认同者理由的表述与之相容，却不给有通达、不认同的位置理由。
detail.en: Internalism: with living significance fully holding, an articulation restricted to endorsers is consistent and withholds the reason from a non-endorsing position with access.

limitations.zh: 不证明 S0、N、A、C、L 或 J，不约束拒绝它们的立场，不处理使新生命存在的价值。一项支持理由不是义务、排序，也不预测认识或遵循。Sidgwick 的实践理性二元论没有被消解，只被定位到边界中立这一前提上。
limitations.en: Proves none of S0, N, A, C, L or J, binds no position rejecting them, and does not treat the value of bringing new lives into existence. A contributory reason is not a duty or ranking and predicts no recognition or compliance. Sidgwick's dualism of practical reason is not dissolved; it is located at the boundary-neutrality premise.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：本结果所在的 Becoming.Metaethics（不含其后加的读法一节与逐步读法一节，见 becoming-renewal-reading、becoming-stepwise-reading）、Becoming.Inquiry、Becoming.Frame 共有 20、5、11 项定理（Becoming.Inquiry 另有一项判断定理，属 becoming-spine-instances），全部空依赖。检查器要求脊柱模块无任何公理依赖；继承模块的 propext、Quot.sound、Classical.choice 依赖另列，未迁移。控制例不计为新定理；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。作者自审，尚无独立反审。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): this result's Becoming.Metaethics (excluding the later reading and stepwise-reading sections, see becoming-renewal-reading and becoming-stepwise-reading), Becoming.Inquiry and Becoming.Frame have 20, 5 and 11 theorems (Becoming.Inquiry has one further judgment theorem, recorded in becoming-spine-instances), all with empty axiom reports. The checker requires the spine to have no axiom dependency; inherited propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice dependencies are listed separately and not migrated. Controls are not counted as new theorems; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. Author's review only; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.en: Independent review of A's externalist defence and N's philosophical warrant; run-independent readings of `living` and `related`, connected to universal_reason; the reading chosen for comparison still needs its philosophical argument.
